g.text: These are local observations on this device, not provider billing. A call counts once the CLI rendered its
output; rendered does not mean pasted. Triggers with an explicit provider (-i-, -ip-, -if-, -iok-, -il-,
Usage history is on (PROMPT_HISTORY=true, the default): metadata only (when a trigger ran, which trigger,
profile, provider and model, the outcome, latency, tokens and the cost the provider reported), never your
draft, clipboard, rewrite, persona or keys.
It stays on this device, in /home/me/.local/share/promptmend/history.sqlite3, for 365 days.
Switch it off: `promptmend config set PROMPT_HISTORY false` (or PROMPT_HISTORY=false in your .env);
